text: Program Description Pharmaceutical is to develop pharmaceutical disciplines basic theory, basic knowledge and experimental skills, and can be used in drug manufacturing, inspection, distribution, and research and development field in identification, drug design, general pharmaceutical preparations and clinical rational drug use of advanced science and technology talents. Training Requirements The students mainly study medicine major branch of basic theory and basic knowledge, by pharmaceutical experiment methods and skills of basic training, with a drug preparation, quality control, evaluation and the basic ability to guide rational drug use. Duration 3 years
